title: Satay Tofu Fried Rice
subtitle: with Sugar Snap Peas and Spring Onion
description: Craving a dinner that’s delightfully delish and easy to get on the table? We’re on a mission to make cooking more fun, extra yum and even simpler – this recipe, packed with quality fresh ingredients, is all that and more. Get cooking!

steps.text: Cook rice: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice and cook for 12 mins or until tender. Drain.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, trim the stems from the sugar snap peas, removing the strings from one side. Halve the carrot lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Thinly slice the spring onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Quarter the tofu pieces.

Make satay tofu: Combine the garlic, peanut butter, 2 tsp soy sauce, ½ tsp sugar and 60ml (¼ cup) warm water in a bowl. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium heat and cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Add the satay sauce and cook, stirring, for 3-4 mins until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat and cover to keep warm.

Make fried rice: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over high heat (see Kitchen 101). Stir-fry the sugar snap peas and carrot for 2 mins or until tender but still with crunch. Add the rice and ayam goreng paste and cook, breaking up the rice with a spoon, for 3-4 mins until well combined. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the fried rice among bowls, top with the satay tofu and scatter over the spring onion. Enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Want to know the secrets to stir-fry perfection? Have everything prepped and ready to go before you start cooking. And fast and hot is key: make sure you cook over high heat, stirring constantly so everything is cooked evenly. We've used a deep frypan, but you can use a wok if you have one.
